description.en: An opinionated shadcn/ui registry of high-character components for React and Svelte 5, featuring ASCII fluid, GLSL shaders, and organic motion.
description.zh: 极具个性表达的 shadcn/ui 组件注册表：支持 React 与 Svelte 5，涵盖 ASCII 流体、GLSL 着色器天象与有机动效。

content.en: 23rd is an opinionated component registry built on top of the shadcn ecosystem, providing ready-to-ship, distinctive UI elements for developers and design engineers. Supporting both React and Svelte 5 through the standard shadcn CLI, it breaks away from generic component templates by committing to bold aesthetics: interactive ASCII fluid simulations, responsive GLSL shader skies and fire tongues, CRT phosphor music rain, Bayer-dithered 404 pages, and perspective 3D spring-scroll folios. Each element comes with carefully calibrated default physics, radii, and typography that feel instantly finished.
content.zh: 23rd 是一套基于 shadcn 生态的极具设计主张的组件注册表，专为追求鲜明视觉与交互张力的前端开发者打造。全库支持通过标准 shadcn CLI 一键安装到 React 或 Svelte 5 项目中。不同于常规组件库求稳的平庸基调，23rd 勇敢选择了极具辨识度的技术与艺术结合路线：包含交互式 ASCII 流体模拟、GLSL 着色器天空与火舌、CRT 荧光流坠、拜尔点阵（Bayer）抖动 404 画布，以及视角后倾的 3D 弹簧翻页效果。所有组件均自带精调的空间、动效手感与配色默认值，开箱即拥有极高完成度。
